title: Invertibility and monoidal coherence of the normalized exact derived tensor comparison
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be closed symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian categories with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with their fixed K-flat derived tensor structures [lem-sfb-derived-monoidal]. Flat means that tensoring on either side preserves short exact sequences; K-flat complexes and the signed direct-sum total tensor are as in [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso].
Let $F:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be an additive exact left adjoint with a specified strong monoidal structure [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], preserving flat objects and K-flat complexes. Write $F_{\rm Ch}$ for its termwise functor and $\tau_{P,Q}:F_{\rm Ch}(P\otimes Q)\cong F_{\rm Ch}P\otimes F_{\rm Ch}Q$ for the direct-sum total comparison induced by the inverse ordinary tensorator. Put $E=D(F)$, let $Q_{\mathcal C},Q_{\mathcal D}$ be localization from complexes, and let $\kappa_P:E Q_{\mathcal C}P\cong Q_{\mathcal D}F_{\rm Ch}P$ be the canonical exact-functor factorization.
Let $m_{\mathcal C;P,Q}:Q_{\mathcal C}(P\otimes Q)\cong Q_{\mathcal C}P\otimes^{\mathbf L}Q_{\mathcal C}Q$ and $m_{\mathcal D}$ be the native K-flat model comparisons. Let $t:E(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}L)\to EK\otimes^{\mathbf L}EL$ be the natural comparison of [lem-pur-derived-tensor-comparison], normalized for every K-flat pair $P,Q$ by
$$(\kappa_P\otimes\kappa_Q)\circ t_{Q_{\mathcal C}P,Q_{\mathcal C}Q}\circ E(m_{\mathcal C;P,Q})=m_{\mathcal D;FP,FQ}\circ Q_{\mathcal D}(\tau_{P,Q})\circ\kappa_{P\otimes Q}.$$
Write $u_{\mathcal C}:Q_{\mathcal C}(\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}[0])\cong\mathbf1_{D(\mathcal C)}$ and $u_{\mathcal D}$ for the native unit models, and $e_F:\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}\cong F\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}$ for the ordinary unit map. Define
$$e=u_{\mathcal D}\circ Q_{\mathcal D}(e_F^{-1}[0])\circ\kappa_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}[0]}\circ E(u_{\mathcal C}^{-1}).$$
Then every $t_{K,L}$ is invertible and, for all $K,L,M$, the native derived associator $\alpha$ and unitors $\lambda,\rho$ satisfy
$$(1\otimes t_{L,M})\circ t_{K,L\otimes^{\mathbf L}M}\circ E(\alpha_{K,L,M})=\alpha_{EK,EL,EM}\circ(t_{K,L}\otimes1)\circ t_{K\otimes^{\mathbf L}L,M},$$
$$E(\lambda_K)=\lambda_{EK}\circ(e\otimes1)\circ t_{\mathbf1,K},\qquad E(\rho_K)=\rho_{EK}\circ(1\otimes e)\circ t_{K,\mathbf1}.$$
Thus $t^{-1},e^{-1}$ give a strong monoidal structure on $E$ with exactly these normalized maps. No compatibility of $F$ with a braiding is assumed or asserted.

proof.text: Grothendieck abelian categories have small colimits. Closedness and symmetry make tensoring on either side a colimit-preserving left adjoint; the given left adjoint F preserves colimits too. Thus mapCochainComplexMonoidal from [lem-sfb-termwise-strong-monoidal] gives the strong monoidal termwise functor, with inverse tensorator (F.mapCochainComplexμIso P Q).inv and inverse unit F.mapCochainComplexεIso.inv. Its three coherence equations are already proved in the source library.

proof.text: The two-sided predicate IsKFlatForTotalTensor of [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso] is definitionally the native quasiIso.kFlat predicate, since the native complex whiskerings are the indicated total tensor maps. The native kFlat.IsMonoidal instance equips its full subcategory with tensor and unit. Resolve Q.objPreimage K using CochainComplex.exists_quasiIso_flat_kFlat from [lem-sfb-abstract-kflat-resolution], then localize the quasi-isomorphism: every derived K has a K-flat complex model QP ≅ K. The complex tensor and its homotopy localization are the fixed signed ones of [lem-sfb-total-tensor-homotopy].

proof.text: For a native K-flat Q, pass to its homotopy quotient using kFlat_quotient_obj_iff. DerivedMonoidal.isIso_counit_app_app_of_kFlat_right from the native structure [lem-sfb-derived-monoidal] says that the tensorator of Qh is invertible. The quotient-to-derived factorization transfers this to μ Q P Q. The unit tensorator ε Q is likewise invertible. Apply the displayed normalization on K-flat P,Q. Its left side is a composite of isomorphisms, and the right side is t followed by two isomorphisms, since FQ is K-flat by hKFlat. Cancel the latter factors to prove t invertible on model pairs. Naturality with respect to QP ≅ K and QQ ≅ L then proves t invertible on every pair.

proof.text: Package the given natural family t as a natural transformation δ between the two derived tensor bifunctors. Apply the proved source-library construction OplaxMonoidal.ofLaxSquare with source the monoidal full subcategory of K-flat complexes, q = ι ⋙ Q_C, f = ι ⋙ F_Ch, target localization Q_D, and factorization components κ_P. Its compatibility equation is exactly the assumed normalization, since ι has identity monoidal maps. Its object-surjectivity premise is Step 2; its target tensorator premise is Step 3 and the hypothesis that F preserves K-flat complexes. This yields the native associativity and both unit identities by the already proved cross-square cancellation argument. To identify its unit, expand singleFunctorObjUnitIso: the inverse native unit model is exactly ε Q. Therefore its unit E(ε Q_C);κ_I;Q_D(F_Ch.η);(ε Q_D)⁻¹ equals the explicitly prescribed exactDerivedTensorUnitIso.hom. The source construction uses only the termwise oplax monoidal equations, without braiding compatibility of F.

lean.statement: theorem exactDerivedTensorComparison_normalization (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] [F.IsLeftAdjoint] [F.Monoidal] [F.PreservesFlat] (hKFlat : ∀ P : CochainComplex C ℤ, P.IsKFlatForTotalTensor → CochainComplex.IsKFlatForTotalTensor ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) (t : ∀ K L : DerivedCategory C, F.mapDerivedCategory.obj (K ⊗ L) ⟶ F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K ⊗ F.mapDerivedCategory.obj L) (ht : ∀ (K K' L L' : DerivedCategory C) (a : K ⟶ K') (b : L ⟶ L'), F.mapDerivedCategory.map (a ⊗ₘ b) ≫ t K' L' = t K L ≫ (F.mapDerivedCategory.map a ⊗ₘ F.mapDerivedCategory.map b)) (hnorm : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex C ℤ, P.IsKFlatForTotalTensor → Q.IsKFlatForTotalTensor → F.mapDerivedCategory.map (LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q P Q) ≫ F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app (P ⊗ Q) ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (F.mapCochainComplexμIso P Q).inv = t (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫ (F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P ⊗ₘ F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q) ≫ LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) : (∀ K L : DerivedCategory C, IsIso (t K L)) ∧ (∀ K L M : DerivedCategory C, F.mapDerivedCategory.map (α_ K L M).hom ≫ t K (L ⊗ M) ≫ (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K ◁ t L M) = t (K ⊗ L) M ≫ (t K L ▷ F.mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫ (α_ (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K) (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj L) (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj M)).hom) ∧ (∀ K : DerivedCategory C, F.mapDerivedCategory.map (λ_ K).hom = t (𝟙_ _) K ≫ ((F.exactDerivedTensorUnitIso).hom ▷ F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫ (λ_ (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K)).hom) ∧ (∀ K : DerivedCategory C, F.mapDerivedCategory.map (ρ_ K).hom = t K (𝟙_ _) ≫ (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K ◁ (F.exactDerivedTensorUnitIso).hom) ≫ (ρ_ (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj K)).hom) ∧ (∃ s : F.mapDerivedCategory.CoreMonoidal, s.εIso = (F.exactDerivedTensorUnitIso).symm ∧ ∀ K L : DerivedCategory C, (s.μIso K L).inv = t K L)
